summary: Don is a 2006 Indian Hindi-language action thriller. Farhan Akhtar co-wrote and directed it. Excel Entertainment produced it. It remakes the 1978 film of the same title. Shah Rukh Khan plays the anti-hero Don. Priyanka Chopra plays Roma. Don manages a drug cartel's Kuala Lumpur operations. After Don is wounded in a chase, police recruit his look-alike, Vijay. Vijay impersonates Don to gather intelligence on the cartel. In the final twist, Don had survived and switched places with Vijay. Farhan Akhtar co-wrote it with his father, Javed Akhtar. Javed Akhtar co-wrote the original with Salim Khan. The remake added an international setting and a different climax. Most filming took place in Malaysia. Shankar–Ehsaan–Loy composed the soundtrack. It was released on 20 October 2006, at Diwali. Critics praised its action, music, design and lead performances. It grossed ₹106 crore against a ₹40 crore budget. It was 2006's fifth-highest-grossing Hindi film. It won Best Asian Film at the Neuchâtel festival. It received 9 Filmfare nominations. Don 2 followed in 2011.
